component.name: OpenDisplay for X11
component.summary: Use your iPad as a second monitor over USB

description.p: Plug in your iPad, open the OpenDisplay app, and your desktop extends onto it. Tap, drag, scroll and right-click work on the iPad.
Requirement: your computer needs a free HDMI or DisplayPort socket with nothing plugged in. Works on X11 desktops (not Wayland), and not with NVIDIA's own driver.
An unofficial sender for the OpenDisplay iPad app, not affiliated with the OpenDisplay project.
Updates that only change the settings window no longer interrupt the iPad.
Clearer settings window: Start at login under Settings, plainer names, the setup checklist under Help.
Updates apply on their own: the service restarts onto the new version after an upgrade.
Quieter: notifications only when you need to act. Listed under Utility.
Settings window, desktop notifications, automatic port choice, and settings that apply live.
